authority.rule: Accepted brief clauses 7, 8.1, 13 and 17 require exact normative dependencies, row-semantic selection identity, compatible predecessor reuse, and fail-closed behaviour. Stage-1-closed rows must be publicly reachable end to end under the amended ExecPlan.

finding: The worker completed the three-leaf Stage-1 candidate and the amended cross-stage boundary removes the prior false requirement to materialise Stage-2 predecessors. The first remaining genuine Stage-1 invariant fails within the 144 Stage-1-closed rows: recursive predecessor resolution cannot lawfully change selection granularity from an aggregate/multi-entity parent row to narrower per-contract predecessor rows. The public materialiser recursively invokes each Stage-1 predecessor with the same CalculationRequestV1/InputSelectionPolicyVersion as the parent. D087 requires one exact option contract identity, while D109 requires a call/put pair at one expiry/strike and D170 requires multiple candidate legs. A pair-level parent policy is rejected by D087 for missing exact-contract keys; a full-contract parent policy cannot merge the differing call/put or leg identities. Therefore D109 and D170 are not publicly reachable even when all lawful raw facts, contexts, mappings and unit conventions are supplied.

independent_evidence.mechanism_observation: api._materialise recursively calls a Stage-1 predecessor with the unchanged parent request and selection_ref. The selected identity accumulator then expects one common value for the parent selection keys. This cannot represent a parent whose lawful dependency is a set of narrower per-contract predecessor occurrences.

repair_proposition: Close the Stage-1 selection-identity class across parent/child scope changes. A Stage-1 aggregate, pair, basket or candidate-structure row must lawfully resolve the exact set of narrower predecessor occurrences required by its normative dependency semantics, with each predecessor calculated/reused under the predecessor row's own mandatory selection identity, while the parent retains and proves its aggregate selection meaning and exact lineage. Do not weaken D087 exact-contract selection to make an aggregate row pass. Add authority-derived public-seam proof for at least D109 resolving separate call and put D087 occurrences and D170 resolving per-leg D087 occurrences, including mismatch/absence refusal and exact predecessor lineage. Repair only this Stage-1 graph-selection mechanism, rerun the relevant Stage-1 regression, freeze a new Stage-1 candidate, and return for fresh independent review. Do not start Stage 2.
